tools.name: track_record_lookup
tools.description: Look up AEIG's calls by topic, claim ID or date range. Returns each call's statement, locked probability or range, lock date, resolution rule, status, outcome and integrity proof (claims file hash, locked-fields hash, snapshot). Score figures are withheld until the public score rrule allows them. Giv

tools.name: verify_call
tools.description: Prove that a call was locked before its outcome. Returns the lock and resolution dates, the first public snapshot that lists the call, the canonical locked fields with their SHA-256, and the hash chain path from the call to the published manifest and snapshot files, so the proof can be checked indep
